events.title: cART-ography: An Arts, Culture, and Sustainability Workshop
events.summary: Explore the political dimensions of mapping and geography through a hands-on collage workshop. Learn about countermapping, which highlights hidden histories and environmental justice, and create your own maps. Dinner is provided.

evidence.description: Countermapping is a radical way to use the tools of mapping in a way that engages with our environment in a politically explicit way. It can bring to light hidden histories of structural environmental discrimination, subvert dominant claims about space, and highlight ongoing struggles for decolonization and justice. In this workshop, we’ll think about the political dimensions of mapping, geography, and the environment, especially in the local context. Then, we’ll create our own countermaps using collage, a fun medium friendly to all levels of artistic experience. Plus, dinner is provided!

evidence.description: Last Call Improv takes over Thursday nights at 9:30 PM for a wild, dynamic mix of styles and forms. Following right after the regular Thursday show, this late-night staple features a rotating lineup of performance troupes hand-picked from open submissions. The evening is anchored by Wanted Live , a featured headliner performing a TJ and Dave-style long-form improv set, where grounded, authentic human behavior drives the comedy. Whether you are looking for experimental forms or high-energy laughs, Last Call Improv offers an unpredictable, one-of-a-kind experience every single week.
